question: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Abismal"** is incorrectly spelt. The correct spelling is **"Abysmal"** which means extremely bad or appalling. (अत्यन्त बुरा)

 
 
• **Example:** The quality of the service was abysmal.
 
 
 
• **"Allocation"** refers to the process of distributing something. (वितरण)
 
 
• **Example:** The allocation of resources was fair and efficient.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Allegation** (आरोप): A claim or assertion that someone has done something illegal or wrong, typically one made without proof.

 
 
• **Example:** The allegation that he was involved in the fraud was unfounded.
 
 
 
• **Aversion** (घृणा): A strong dislike or disinclination.
 
 
• **Example:** He has a natural aversion to heights.
